name: Kikyou
source: A beautiful assassin directly under Imae Yoshinori's command. Trained as a kunoichi, her exceptional combat skills led to her specializing in the more dangerous task of assassination. Her work is precise - she has never missed a target. Raised from birth in a ninja village, Kikyou knows no other life; for her, "living" is synonymous with "killing people".
